zeropvpthings.title: Zero's PVP Things
zeropvpthings.option.highlight.tooltip: Color inventory slots based on the item inside.
zeropvpthings.option.highlight_hotbar.to: Also color the slots of your hotbar HUD.
zeropvpthings.option.highlight_style.too: Fill the slot, outline it, or both.
zeropvpthings.option.highlight_opacity.t: How strong the highlight color is.
zeropvpthings.option.highlight_rules.too: Choose which items get which color.
zeropvpthings.option.scaler.tooltip:
Make inventories bigger or smaller without touching GUI Scale.
In an inventory press = / - to change it, 0 to reset.
zeropvpthings.option.scale_all.tooltip: Scale chests, furnaces etc. too, not just your own inventory.
zeropvpthings.option.inventory_scale.too: Size of inventory screens. Clamped so it always fits the window.
zeropvpthings.option.scale_step.tooltip: How much each = / - press changes the scale.
zeropvpthings.option.momentum.tooltip: Replace the XP bar with a bar showing your horizontal speed.
zeropvpthings.option.momentum_number.too: Show blocks/second where the XP level normally is.
zeropvpthings.option.momentum_style.tool: Gradient bar or the vanilla XP bar texture.
zeropvpthings.option.momentum_max.toolti: Speed that fills the whole bar. Sprint-jumping is about 7 b/s.
zeropvpthings.option.gamma.tooltip: Use the brightness below instead of the vanilla slider. Toggle key: G.
zeropvpthings.option.gap.tooltip: While eating a golden apple, show how much health (incl. absorption) you lost in total.
zeropvpthings.option.gap_hearts.tooltip: Show hearts instead of health points.
zeropvpthings.option.gap_linger.tooltip: How long to keep the result on screen after eating.
zeropvpthings.option.crosshair.tooltip: Replace the vanilla crosshair with your own.
zeropvpthings.option.crosshair_attack.to: Keep the attack cooldown indicator under the custom crosshair (when set to Crosshair in vanilla settings).
zeropvpthings.option.crosshair_editor.to: Create, scale and import crosshairs (Marvel Rivals codes supported).
zeropvpthings.option.customhud.tooltip: Show the text HUD from the active profile.
zeropvpthings.option.customhud_folder.to: Open the folder with the profile files.
zeropvpthings.crosshair.title: Crosshair Editor
zeropvpthings.crosshair.dynamic_gap.tool: Spread the crosshair while your attack is recharging.
zeropvpthings.crosshair.code_hint: Paste a Marvel Rivals or ZPVP1: code
zeropvpthings.crosshair.import.tooltip: Accepts Marvel Rivals reticle codes (e.g. 3;1;10.0,10.0,...) and ZPVP1: codes exported from this editor.
zeropvpthings.rules.title: Highlight Rules
zeropvpthings.rules.help: item id, #tag or glob (*_sword)  |  #RRGGBB  |  first match wins
zeropvpthings.customhud.title: CustomHUD Editor
zeropvpthings.customhud.heading: CustomHUD - profile_%s.txt
zeropvpthings.variables.title: CustomHUD Variables
